reason_for_inclusion: A stable, actively maintained, mid-sized desktop application written in C++ and Qt, with clear desktop architecture and security-critical components.
what_it_tests: C++ and Qt architecture, UI and backend separation, security-focused design, plugin understanding, and persistence handling in a desktop app.
risks_or_caveats: C++ GUI code can be challenging for some agents, and it requires reasoning across both system-level and interface layers.

reason_for_inclusion: A maintained Android application with real-world mobile complexity and reliance on unstable external service behavior rather than formal SDKs.
what_it_tests: Android app architecture, network-layer resilience, UI patterns, media playback integration, and adaptation to changing unofficial APIs.
risks_or_caveats: Its scraping-heavy network layer is less formally structured than typical API clients, which may confuse agents expecting standard client patterns.

reason_for_inclusion: A robust and architecturally unusual C database engine whose amalgamated build structure is adversarial but fair for architecture inference.
what_it_tests: Deep C analysis, database-engine structure, unconventional file layout, and whether an agent can infer architecture beyond superficial directories.
risks_or_caveats: Predominantly C and layout-unconventional. Agents that rely on file structure shortcuts may fail badly.

reason_for_inclusion: A modern mid-sized Go application with a modular plugin-based server architecture and meaningful concurrency patterns.
what_it_tests: Go application structure, plugin systems, concurrency, HTTP handling, and modular non-framework application reasoning.
risks_or_caveats: Static analysis may understate dynamic plugin behavior, and Go may still be underrepresented for some models.

reason_for_inclusion: A small but architecturally clear C utility with OS interaction, event loops, and text UI rendering.
what_it_tests: OS-facing C code, ncurses-style UI architecture, event-driven programming, and architecture extraction from a compact codebase.
risks_or_caveats: Its small size limits breadth, and the C plus terminal-UI domain may be niche for some models.

reason_for_inclusion: A hybrid C and Lua application with rich extensibility, long-lived complexity, and a real plugin-heavy architecture.
what_it_tests: Multi-language architecture, plugin boundaries, editor core versus extension logic, and dynamic extension-aware analysis.
risks_or_caveats: Macros in C and dynamic Lua behavior can make holistic static analysis difficult.
